author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete
GO:0033218 amide binding -> replace with GO:0005488 binding
GO:0043604 amide biosynthetic process -> replace with GO:0009058 biosynthetic process
GO:0043605 amide catabolic process -> replace with GO:0009056 catabolic process 
GO:0034251 regulation of amide catabolic process -> replace with GO:0009894 regulation of catabolic process
GO:0034253 positive regulation of amide catabolic process -> replace with GO:0009896 positive regulation of catabolic process
GO:0034252 negative regulation of amide catabolic process -> replace with GO:0009895 negative regulation of catabolic process
GO:0043603 amide metabolic process -> replace with GO:0008152 metabolic process
GO:0034248 regulation of amide metabolic process -> replace with GO:0019222 regulation of metabolic process
GO:0034250 positive regulation of amide metabolic process -> replace with GO:0009893 positive regulation of metabolic process
GO:0034249 negative regulation of amide metabolic process -> replace with GO:0009892 negative regulation of metabolic process
GO:0042887 amide transmembrane transporter activity -> replace with GO:0022857 transmembrane transporter activity
GO:0042886 amide transport -> replace with GO:0071705 nitrogen compound transport

Suggest changing the annotation to parent term has_input (a specific amide, such as capsaicin).

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31123

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13aJ5ruWlf-SAIsYfHq7Nk-esl9yLHhoNP55dHFnehXE


Impacted groups: 
PseudoCAP	4
RGD	5
UniProt	8
AspGD	6
CACAO	1
SGD	2

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
GO:0033218	interpro2go	InterPro:IPR039570 AmiC, periplasmic binding domain > GO:amide binding ; GO:0033218



Thanks.
title: Review annotations to amide metabolic process and related terms

Sara
